description: The journey expands through India, Rome and visions of possible futures as Xena and Gabrielle confront fate, spiritual transformation and the cost of trying to change what seems inevitable.

s04e01.description: In “Adventures In The Sin Trade Part One”, Xena and Gabrielle face a new conflict shaped by myth, war or Xena’s past, testing how far redemption can survive the consequences of violence.
